A key above 17 or below 0 is MIDI. pianoSoundingPitchClasses returns mod 12 and skips the heuristic. Keys 14 and 17 beside 0–11 stay on the heuristic. transposePianoKeys does not throw. chord-dict.ts does not import define.ts. Guitar and ukulele packs were not edited.

0–11 keys keep the candidate path and store 60 + pc when neither candidate reads the shifted classes. 0–17 keys that include 12–17 shift sounding classes inside 0–11 and do not add n to the raw interval. MIDI adds n and does not fold with 60 + (mod 12). If a result is <= 17, every key is lifted by the same multiple of 12 until each is > 17.

{define: D9 keys 0 4 7 14} draws D F# A E (pcs 2, 6, 9, 4). +2 stores E9 keys [4, 8, 11, 6] and draws E G# B F#. exportCho of that chart does not throw.

{define: D keys 50 52} draws D and E (pcs 2, 4). {define: C keys 48 50} +2 stores [50, 52] and draws D and E.
